MVP backlog: 17 originals + W18 (multi-variant day plans, mid-session addition). Wave 0 (W1,W2) is foundational and unblocks 7 wave-1 items; W18 is wave 4 (stacked behind W6 plan-day). Backend Edge Functions stubbed; migrations + KMP scoring/types exist. Drive each item with /spec-driven-workflow <id>; reconcile with /sprint-pulse.

items.title: Secrets & config plumbing across Edge Functions and clients
acceptanceCriteria: Edge Functions read CLAUDE_API_KEY, GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY, and INGEST_SECRET from the environment via a single typed config helper (e.g. _shared/env.ts) that throws a clear error when a required var is missing.
A documented local secrets flow exists: supabase/.env.example lists every required var; `supabase functions serve --env-file` picks them up locally; production uses `supabase secrets set`.
iOS Config.xcconfig and Android local.properties carry SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and a documented way to point at the local stack (http://localhost:54321) vs prod.
No secret is committed; .gitignore covers .env and Config.xcconfig (verify the existing ignore rules).
items.notes: Foundational. Blocks every backend slice and auth.

items.title: TS ↔ Kotlin types + scoring contract
acceptanceCriteria: shared/types.ts (repo root — matches the existing find-spots/plan-day imports) exists and is the canonical TypeScript mirror of shared/.../Types.kt (FindSpotsRequest/Response, ScoredSpot, ScoreBreakdown, Event, OptimizationTarget, PlanDayResponse, LogInteractionRequest, et al). The find-spots stub already imports ../../../shared/types.ts — that import must resolve.
_shared/scoring.ts mirrors shared/.../Scoring.kt deterministically: identical 5-signal math (consensus, recency, useCaseFit, distance, realTimeRelevance) for the same inputs.
A parity check (a small test or documented fixture) demonstrates one shared input produces the same ScoreBreakdown in Kotlin and TS.
A heuristicVersion constant exists in both and matches, per docs/architecture.md § lockstep.
items.notes: Foundational. Blocks find-spots, plan-day, events-query, log-interaction, XCFramework. | Spec-phase correction: TS types live at repo-root shared/types.ts (where find-spots/plan-day already import from), not supabase/functions/shared/.

items.title: Google Places client (text search + distance matrix)
acceptanceCriteria: _shared/places.ts exposes textSearch(purpose, location) → candidate venues (id, name, address, lat/lng, rating, hours) and distanceMatrix(origin, candidates) → walk minutes per candidate.
Uses GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY from the env helper (W1); fails with a clear error if absent.
Handles the API's pagination + rate-limit responses gracefully and normalizes results to the shared candidate shape.
A documented fixture/replay path lets find-spots be developed without burning live quota.
items.notes: Shared client consumed by find-spots, plan-day (via find-spots), enrich-business.

items.title: Claude judge client (purpose→attributes, fit, why-copy)
acceptanceCriteria: _shared/claude.ts exposes: purposeToAttributes(purpose) → weighted use-case attributes; scoreUseCaseFit(purpose, candidate) → 0..1 fit; whyCopy(purpose, candidate, breakdown) → one-line rationale; and extractEvents(text) → Event[] for ingestion.
Calls the Claude API with the current recommended model id and reads CLAUDE_API_KEY from the env helper (W1).

Prompts/system messages live in a single place and are the codification of the find-spots SKILL.md spec; responses are parsed into typed shapes (W2) with validation + graceful fallback on malformed output.
Token/cost guardrails documented (batch where possible).
items.notes: Consult the claude-api skill before implementing. Shared client for find-spots, plan-day, events-feed, ingest-events, enrich-business.

items.title: Events query layer (PostGIS KNN by geo + time)
acceptanceCriteria: _shared/events.ts exposes nearbyEvents(location, radius, timeWindow) → Event[] using the events table PostGIS index (migration 00000000000002), and upsertEvents(events) keyed by canonical_key.
Returns events typed per the shared Event shape (W2), ordered by proximity + recency.
Used by both the find-spots real-time-relevance signal and events-feed without duplicating SQL.
items.notes: Shared query owner so find-spots and events-feed don't both write the PostGIS query.

items.title: log-interaction Edge Function (feedback-loop write)
acceptanceCriteria: POST /functions/v1/log-interaction accepts a LogInteractionRequest (W2) and writes to the user_feedback_loop tables (migration 00000000000006), RLS-scoped to auth.uid().
Fire-and-forget contract honored: returns 202/200 fast; never blocks the client.
verify_jwt = true enforced; an unauthenticated call is rejected.
Invalid payloads return 400 with a typed error.
items.notes: Independent of the ranking pipeline; only needs config + types.

items.title: import-business-registries cron (NYC Open Data + NYS)
acceptanceCriteria: POST /functions/v1/import-business-registries pulls from the documented NYC Open Data sources (DCWP, DOHMH, SLA, DCA) + NYS Dept of State and upserts into business_universe (migration 00000000000005) keyed by (source_registry, source_id).
New rows are queued for enrichment (the hand-off W11 consumes).
verify_jwt = false + x-ingest-secret guard enforced (W1 secret); an unguarded call is rejected.
Writes a row to business_ingest_runs for observability.
items.notes: Monthly bulk import; first link of the business-universe moat pipeline.

items.title: Auth: Supabase email magic link (anon → user JWT)
acceptanceCriteria: ApiClient (shared + iOS + Android) sends the authenticated user JWT instead of the anon key on user-facing calls; anon key is no longer used as the bearer for find-spots/plan-day/events-feed/log-interaction.
A minimal login surface (email magic link, redirect pulse://) exists on iOS and Android; an unauthenticated launch routes to it.
Session persists across app launches and refreshes per supabase config (refresh-token rotation already enabled in config.toml).
README launch note updated: the 'sends anon key; swap to user JWT before launch' ⏳ item is closed.
items.notes: Phase-2 auth per docs/architecture.md. Sign in with Apple/Google deferred to Phase 3.

items.title: KMP XCFramework wiring for iOS (drop hand-mirrored Models.swift)
acceptanceCriteria: shared builds SharedKit.xcframework via `./gradlew :shared:assembleSharedKitXCFramework`.
ios/project.yml uncomments the SharedKit dependency + the KMP preBuildScript (already templated in project.yml) so xcodegen embeds the framework and rebuilds it on demand.
ios/Pulse/Models.swift hand-mirror is replaced by `import SharedKit`; types + scoring come from KMP. The app builds Release cleanly.
A `fastlane beta` build still succeeds end-to-end with the framework embedded.
items.notes: Closes the 'XCFramework wiring is the next step' ⏳ item. Independent of backend.

items.title: find-spots Edge Function — hybrid ranking pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: POST /functions/v1/find-spots replaces the stub: Places text search (W3) → distance matrix (W3) → Claude judgments (W4) → nearby live events (W7) → deterministic 5-signal scoring (W2 scoring.ts) → ranked ScoredSpot[] split into tiers (top maxResults, default 10).

Each ScoredSpot carries the full ScoreBreakdown (consensus, recency, useCaseFit, distance, realTimeRelevance) and a 'why' line — the worked cocktail example from find-spots SKILL.md produces a sensible ranked list.
purpose + location required (keep the stub's 400 validation); errors return typed JSON.
verify_jwt = true enforced.
items.notes: The core feature. plan-day (W6) and both clients (W16/W17) depend on it.

items.title: events-feed Edge Function — read + live-search fallback + dedup
acceptanceCriteria: POST /functions/v1/events-feed reads the events table by geo+time (W7), runs a WebSearch+Claude extraction fallback (W4) for the last ~15-min gap, merges + dedups by canonical_key, and upserts new live-search events back (W7).
Returns EventsFeedResponse with events + freshness metadata.
verify_jwt = true enforced; typed errors.
items.notes: Foreground real-time path. Independent of find-spots.

items.title: ingest-events cron — poll → Claude extract → upsert
acceptanceCriteria: POST /functions/v1/ingest-events iterates monitored_entities (migration 00000000000004), polls each source, runs Claude extraction (W4) into structured Event[], and upserts into events (W7) by canonical_key.
Writes an event_ingest_runs row (counts, sources, duration) for observability.
verify_jwt = false + x-ingest-secret guard enforced (W1).
Idempotent: re-running over the same window does not duplicate events.
items.notes: Background real-time path (path A in architecture.md).

items.title: enrich-business cron — finish Places match + scrape + LLM fallback
acceptanceCriteria: enrich-business (already ~187 lines — audit what exists first) processes business_universe rows in batches of 20: Google Places match by name+address (W3), homepage scrape for socials, LLM fallback for missing handles (W4), upsert into business_socials (migration 00000000000005/00000000000007).
Updates business_polling_state (tier, next_poll_at) so the polling cadence is set.
verify_jwt = false + x-ingest-secret guard enforced (W1); writes business_ingest_runs.
Handles unmatched/ambiguous businesses without crashing the batch.
items.notes: Partially built (187 lines) — spec phase must diff existing vs spec before scoping.

items.title: plan-day Edge Function — slots + reuse find-spots + day constraints
acceptanceCriteria: POST /functions/v1/plan-day decomposes date+weekday into slots, fills each open slot by reusing the find-spots logic (W5) re-weighted by optimizeFor, then applies day-level constraints in code: geographic threading (no backtracking), energy filter, novelty penalty vs recentPlans, live-event override flagging tradeoffs.
Returns PlanDayResponse as a time-blocked schedule with a tradeoffs callout (matches PlannerView's expected shape).
verify_jwt = true enforced; typed errors.
Reuses find-spots ranking rather than duplicating it (shared internal call).
items.notes: Depends on find-spots ranking; orchestration layer.

items.title: pg_cron schedule + ingest-secret guard wiring (turn the crons on)
acceptanceCriteria: The pg_cron schedules (migration 00000000000003) actually invoke ingest-events (hourly-ish), enrich-business (continuous batches), and import-business-registries (monthly) via pg_net with the x-ingest-secret header.
app_config holds the ingest secret + function base URL; the schedules read from it (no hardcoded secret in SQL).
A documented way to verify a scheduled run fired: event_ingest_runs / business_ingest_runs rows appear after the cadence.
Closes the 'Ingestion cron actually running' ⏳ README item.
items.notes: Integration capstone for the ingestion pipeline; needs all three cron functions to exist.

items.title: iOS: wire Find Spots + Plan Day to the live backend
acceptanceCriteria: PulseView (Find Spots) calls the live find-spots function (W5) with the user JWT (W14) and renders real ScoredSpot rows with the full score breakdown; loading + empty + error states are handled (no more 'Missing config' placeholder).
PlannerView calls the live plan-day function (W6) and renders the time-blocked schedule with tradeoffs.
Types come from SharedKit (W15), not the hand-mirror.
Verified on-device/sim against the local stack: a real query returns a ranked list end-to-end.
items.notes: Client wave. Could start against anon-key + stubs earlier, but full AC needs W5/W6/W14/W15.

items.title: Android: 2-tab rewrite to match iOS + wire to backend
acceptanceCriteria: MainActivity is rewritten from the deprecated 3-route nav to the 2-tab bottom bar (Things to Do / Planner) matching the iOS IA pivot.
Things to Do calls live find-spots (W5) and renders ranked rows with score breakdown; Planner calls live plan-day (W6); both send the user JWT (W14).
Loading/empty/error states handled; types from the KMP :shared module (consumed directly on Android).
Builds and runs on an emulator against the local stack with a real query returning results.
items.notes: Largest client slice (deprecated screens need rewrite). Android consumes :shared directly — no XCFramework dep.

items.title: Multi-variant day plans (carousel of optimization-target variants)
acceptanceCriteria: POST /functions/v1/plan-day-variants accepts a PlanDayVariantsRequest (a PlanDayRequest plus an optional targets: OptimizationTarget[]) and returns a PlanDayVariantsResponse with one PlanDayResponse per requested target.
When `targets` is omitted, the default is ["novelty", "meet-people", "enjoyment", "recovery"] — the four non-balanced OptimizationTarget values, giving the user a meaningful spread.
Each variant is generated by reusing the plan-day logic (W6) with `optimizeFor` set to that variant's target. No copy of slot-decomposition or orchestration code; the wrapper invokes the same module.
PlanDayVariantsRequest / PlanDayVariantsResponse are added to the canonical shared types (Kotlin Types.kt source-of-truth + the TS mirror introduced by W2).

Invalid input (unknown target string, empty `targets` array, duplicate target in `targets`) returns 400 with a named error message; missing dateISO / anchorLocation surfaces plan-day's existing validation as the first variant's error.
scope: supabase/functions/plan-day/index.ts (extract orchestration into a reusable function callable by the wrapper — no behavior change)
items.notes: Mid-session addition (2026-06-12). User asked for "numerous itineraries"; we scoped it to multi-variant SAME-DAY plans (one PlanDayResponse per OptimizationTarget), distinct from multi-DAY trip planning which is a separate post-MVP feature. Wave 4. Out of scope: cross-variant venue dedup, client UI (belongs in W16/W17 follow-ups).
